nodes.label: ActionExecutionLedger (idempotency)
nodes.rationale: Never re-execute a potentially destructive action just because the process crashed after the call.

nodes.label: AgentBrain as Planning Component (not a second runtime)
nodes.norm_label: agentbrain as planning component (not a second runtime)

nodes.label: AgenticRuntime as Canonical Agentic Kernel
nodes.rationale: One canonical execution engine (OBSERVE-PLAN-ACT-VERIFY-RECOVER); other components become planners, strategies, adapters, policies rather than competing loops.

nodes.label: Capability Attenuation
nodes.rationale: A child agent must never obtain more permissions than its parent.

nodes.label: Checkpoint + Rollback (transactional execution)
nodes.rationale: Recovery exists but no snapshot/rollback; PREPARE-SNAPSHOT-ACT-VERIFY-COMMIT/ROLLBACK is P0.

nodes.label: Evidence Engine / EvidenceBundle
nodes.rationale: LLM narration is not proof of execution; a per-mission evidence bundle (hashes, tests, tool calls, approvals) must always win.

nodes.label: Graduated Autonomy / Risk Engine
nodes.rationale: Replace 'auto = allow everything' with a 0-100 risk score gating automatic, logged, confirmed or forbidden actions.

nodes.label: Hierarchical Agent Budget (Global/Mission/Step/Tool)
nodes.rationale: Extends AgentBudget; without absolute and resource/cost budgets an autonomous agent can be technically bounded yet economically uncontrolled.

nodes.label: LeannaSupervisor (central mission authority)
nodes.rationale: Single authority deciding continue/retry/repair/replan/pause/escalate/complete with an explicit state machine.

nodes.label: Closed Learning Loop (StrategyMemory)
nodes.rationale: R5 StrategyMemory reinjects skill reliability into SkillScorer and Planner; recommended chain Mission-Episode-Outcome-Reflection-Lesson-Strategy-Policy.

nodes.label: ToolRegistry Permission Boundary
nodes.rationale: Agent -> ToolRegistry -> PermissionPolicy -> DryRun -> Tool; cited as one of the best architectural choices, must be kept.

nodes.label: Leanna 2.0 Transformation Plan (Phases 0-10)
nodes.rationale: Industrialize the core rather than rewrite; no major new feature before P0.

nodes.label: Accessibility Rules (4.5:1 contrast, color not sole signal)
nodes.norm_label: accessibility rules (4.5:1 contrast, color not sole signal)

nodes.label: Interactive Surface Tokens (--bg-hover / --bg-active)
nodes.rationale: Theme-aware hover/active veils; hardcoded bg-white/N is forbidden because it is invisible in light/sepia themes.

nodes.label: Motion Pro Animation Layer (v2.1)
nodes.rationale: Animate only transform/opacity (filters on wrappers break position:fixed descendants); exits shorter than entries; theme transition lives in @layer base so Tailwind transitions and motion springs are not overridden; decorative effects disabled under reduced motion and high-contrast.

nodes.label: Radius Scale (rounded-md..rounded-2xl)
nodes.rationale: Higher interface layers get larger radii (button < card < popover < modal).

nodes.label: Semantic Color Tokens (--color-success/warning/error/info, --accent-*)
nodes.rationale: Colors express role/state, not raw hue; values are authoritative in src/index.css and the doc table must stay in sync.

nodes.label: Shadow Elevation Scale
nodes.rationale: Shadows must communicate elevation differences, not decoration.

nodes.label: Themes (dark, light, cyberpunk, sepia, high-contrast)
nodes.rationale: v2.1.0 favors sobriety: neutral surfaces, one accent per theme; only cyberpunk keeps neon.

nodes.label: Typography Scale (text-xs..text-2xl)
nodes.rationale: Six standardized Tailwind tiers plus four font weights; migration should map by visual function rather than pixel-for-pixel.

nodes.label: Too Many Brains Problem (parallel execution engines)
nodes.norm_label: too many brains problem (parallel execution engines)
nodes.rationale: AgentBrain, AgenticRuntime, AgentExecutor/AutonomousLoop, Mission Executor, AutonomousExecutive and WorkflowEngine each own a loop; the question 'who owns the next action decision' depends on the path taken, which blocks durable, verifiable autonomy.

nodes.label: Tokens Before Arbitrary Values Principle
nodes.rationale: Components must use CSS tokens and standard Tailwind classes; arbitrary values like text-[13px], rounded-[14px], shadow-[...] are forbidden unless documented, to guarantee consistency across components and themes.
